Impact.d: Increases the damage inflicted by each round.

Range.d: Increases the effective range of this weapon.

Stability.d: How much or little recoil you will experience while firing the weapon.

Handling.d: The speed with which the weapon can be readied and aimed.

Reload Speed.d: The time it takes to reload this weapon.

Aim Assistance.d: The weapon's ability to augment your aim.

Airborne Effectiveness.d: How accurate and stable this weapon is while airborne.

Zoom.d: How much the weapon's scope can zoom in on targets.

Recoil Direction.d: The weapon's tendency to move while firing.

Ammo Generation.d: Ammo progress earned for final blows with this weapon. Primary weapons generate the most progress. Heavy and Special weapons generate additional progress towards the ammo type that they do not use.

Blast Radius.d: Increases the explosion radius of this weapon.

Velocity.d: Increases the speed of projectiles fired by this weapon.

Accuracy.d: How well shots fired by this weapon hit their target.

Draw Time.d: The time in milliseconds it takes to draw an arrow. Release an arrow when fully drawn for maximum damage and speed.

Charge Time.d: The time in milliseconds before a weapon fires.

Swing Speed.d: The speed at which you can launch attacks.

Guard Efficiency.d: Reduces the amount of energy required to guard an attack.

Guard Resistance.d: Damage reduction while guarding with this weapon against most attacks.

Charge Rate.d: How fast this weapon recharges its energy.

Ammo Capacity.d: How many powerful attacks this weapon can launch before ammo is depleted

Guard Endurance.d: How long you can maintain your guard with this weapon.

Shield Duration.d: How long this weapon's shield can be raised.

Magazine.d: The number of shots which can be fired before reloading.

Rounds Per Minute.d: The number of shots per minute this weapon can fire.

Heat Generated.d: The amount of heat generated per shot fired.

Cooling Efficiency.d: How quickly the weapon cools per second when not being fired.

Vent Speed.d: The time it takes to vent this weapon.

Persistence.d: Increases the amount of time that bolts fired by this weapon will linger before expiring.

Weapons.d: Increases weapon reload speed and handling. Increases weapon damage against minor and major combatants.

Health.d: Increases the amount of health you gain each time you pick up an Orb of Power. Reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming a weapon.

Class.d: Reduces your class ability cooldown. Increases the amount of class ability energy provided by all sources.

Grenade.d: Reduces your grenade ability cooldown. Increases the amount of grenade energy from all sources.

Super.d: Increases the amount of Super energy from all sources.

Melee.d: Reduces your melee cooldown. Increases the amount of melee energy from all sources.
